scope: Integrated application workflows and six-route desktop/mobile accessibility

checks.name: First useful Punjab answer and baseline visible above the desktop fold
Skip link, region presets and place search operate with the keyboard
Coordinate entry validates bounds and preserves the empty-is-not-zero rule
Both actual PNG claim exports include full-sized rendered receipts
Fixed decision roles, empty month choice and early-year timing remain explicit
World year and keyboard point inspection use unsmoothed source cells
Coupled afternoon maps and illustration keep their geographic and simulation limits
Six screens fit desktop and 375px mobile and meet automated WCAG 2.1 AA rules
Methods keeps real participant results pending and provides blank study materials
Initial source failure is explicit and retry recovers without zeroed evidence
Area-file failure leaves the official receipt visible and retries successfully
Loading source evidence never flashes a numerical zero
Unavailable live snapshot preserves the historical calendar
Live feeds distinguish failed, stale, header-only and observed-zero states
Place-search outage leaves preset and coordinate alternatives usable
No unhandled JavaScript errors in integrated workflows
